items.title_en: GPT-5.6
items.title_zh: GPT-5.6 版本
items.summary_en: A new GPT-5.6 model appears, signaling continued iteration on the GPT-5 family. Expect refinements in reasoning, safety, and efficiency, reflecting the ongoing cadence of large language model updates.
items.summary_zh: GPT-5.6 版正逐步进入，表示 GPT-5 系列的持续迭代。预计在推理、安全与效率方面有改进，体现大语言模型更新的持续节奏。

items.title_en: ChatGPT Work
items.title_zh: ChatGPT 在工作中的应用
items.summary_en: OpenAI positions ChatGPT as a tool for ambitious work, highlighting capabilities for drafting, research, and collaboration in professional contexts. The messaging signals a push to position ChatGPT as a productivity platform for teams.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 将 ChatGPT 定位为高强度工作场景的工具，突出草拟、研究与协作等功能在专业环境中的应用。此举标志着将 ChatGPT 打造成团队生产力平台的市场策略。

items.title_en: Show HN: 18 Words
items.title_zh: Show HN: 18 Words
items.summary_en: Show HN: 18 Words introduces a minimal writing tool that limits posts to 18 words, prioritizing brevity and speed. It exemplifies a design philosophy where constraints drive clarity and reduce noise.
items.summary_zh: Show HN: 18 Words 展示了一个极简写作工具，帖子被限制为18个单词，强调简洁与快速分享。此举体现了通过约束提升表达清晰度、降低噪声的设计理念。

items.title_en: EU Parliament greenlights Chat Control 1.0
items.title_zh: 欧盟议会通过聊天监控1.0，Breyer：我们的孩子要吃亏
items.summary_en: This marks a major push to enable cross-border scanning of encrypted messages in pursuit of child safety and crime prevention. Critics warn that the measure expands surveillance at the expense of privacy and free expression, while Breyer argues that children will lose out.
items.summary_zh: 这标志着推动跨境扫描加密通讯以提升儿童安全和打击犯罪的重大举措。批评者担心此举侵蚀隐私与言论自由，而Breyer则认为这会让儿童吃亏。

items.title_en: Hy3
items.title_zh: Hy3
items.summary_en: Hy3 is a new AI model introduced by Tencent's research division.
items.summary_zh: Hy3 是腾讯研究部推出的新一代 AI 模型。

items.title_en: My thoughts on the Bun Rust rewrite
items.title_zh: 我对 Bun 的 Rust 重写的一些看法
items.summary_en: The Bun project is exploring a Rust rewrite to address safety and performance limitations of the original runtime. The note discusses why a Rust-based core could improve reliability and tooling integration, while also outlining migration and compatibility challenges that come with rewriting a mature platform.
items.summary_zh: 该文章探讨 Bun 以 Rust 重写核心的原因，强调安全性和性能提升的潜力，以及对可靠性与工具链集成的影响。还提及迁移路线和兼容性挑战等在对成熟平台进行重写时需要权衡的问题。

items.title_en: Muse Spark 1.1
items.title_zh: Muse Spark 1.1 推出
items.summary_en: Meta announces Muse Spark 1.1, an API for deploying and managing models, improving tooling for developers and end-to-end workflows.
items.summary_zh: Meta 公布 Muse Spark 1.1，为开发者提供部署与管理模型的 API，提升工具链与端到端工作流的体验。

items.title_en: GLM 5.2 is nearly as accurate as a human book keeper
items.title_zh: GLM 5.2 的准确度几乎达到人类簿记员水平
items.summary_en: GLM 5.2 achieves VAT benchmark accuracy close to human bookkeepers, showing AI's growing competence in financial tasks. This underscores how automated accounting could reshape back-office operations, prompting discussions on reliability and controls.
items.summary_zh: GLM 5.2 在 VAT 基准测试中的表现接近人类簿记员的水平，体现了 AI 在财务任务上的进步。这将推动自动化记账改变后台运营，同时引发关于可靠性与审控的讨论。

items.title_en: A possible future for Damn Interesting
items.title_zh: Damn Interesting 的未来可能走向
items.summary_en: The article speculates on how Damn Interesting could evolve in the AI era, potentially adopting new formats and monetization models while preserving its science storytelling focus. It weighs challenges like audience fragmentation and sustainable funding.
items.summary_zh: 本文对 Damn Interesting 在 AI 时代的未来走向进行了设想，探讨其在维持科普叙事的同时可能采用的新格式与盈利模式。文章也讨论了观众分化与长期资金可持续性等挑战。

items.title_en: AI content is everywhere on social media, especially LinkedIn
items.title_zh: 社交媒体上的 AI 内容无处不在，LinkedIn 尤为明显
items.summary_en: AI-generated content is proliferating across social media, with LinkedIn showing a particularly high share. This trend accelerates content production for professionals but also challenges readers to assess authenticity and credibility. Platform policies and signal reliability will be key to preserving trust as feeds become more automated.
items.summary_zh: AI 生成的内容正在社交媒体中迅速蔓延，LinkedIn 的表现尤为突出。这一趋势提高了专业内容的产出效率，同时也让读者在辨别真实性和可信度方面面临挑战。平台的信号质量与监管政策将决定在日益自动化的信息流中的信任水平。

items.title_en: John Deere owners will get the right to repair equipment under FTC settlement
items.title_zh: FTC和解赋予约翰迪尔设备的修理权
items.summary_en: An FTC settlement grants John Deere equipment owners the right to repair, potentially lowering downtime and repair costs. It signals a shift toward repairability by nudging OEMs to share tools, manuals, and parts, and could boost independent repair shops. This case could influence broader right-to-repair momentum in tech-enabled farming.
items.summary_zh: FTC与约翰迪尔设备修理权的和解，可能降低停机时间与维修成本，推动制造商提供维修工具、手册与零件。此举或促成独立修理商的兴起，或对农业科技领域的修理权运动产生示范效应。

items.title_en: No leap second will be introduced at the end of December 2026
items.title_zh: 2026 年底将不再加入闰秒
items.summary_en: The International Earth Rotation and Reference Systems Service confirms no leap second will be added at the end of 2026. This continues a trend toward simpler, predictable timekeeping for distributed systems. Engineers should plan around a leap-second-free timeline while staying alert for policy updates.
items.summary_zh: 国际时刻参考系统宣布 2026 年底不再添加闰秒。这延续了简化且可预测的全球时间计量趋势，便于分布式系统的时钟同步。工程师应在无闰秒的时间线下开展计划，并关注未来的政策变动。

items.title_en: US seeks cheaper hunter-killer drones after Iran destroys $1B worth of Reapers
items.title_zh: 在伊朗摧毁 10 亿美元 Reapers 之后，美国寻求更便宜的猎杀无人机
items.summary_en: The US seeks cheaper hunter-killer drones after Iran destroyed a large Reaper fleet, signaling a shift toward more cost-effective, mass-produced platforms and potential changes in defense procurement.
items.summary_zh: 在伊朗摧毁价值数亿美元的 Reapers 后，美国转向寻求更便宜的猎杀无人机，显示出对成本效益更高、可规模化生产平台的需求，或将改变国防采购格局。

items.title_en: The glass backbone: Why the Army's logistics will break in the next war
items.title_zh: 玻璃脊梁：未来战争中陆军后勤为何会崩溃
items.summary_en: The piece argues that modern military logistics rely on a fragile, highly digitized backbone, making supply chains vulnerable in future conflicts. It discusses failure points and resilience strategies like redundancy and decentralization.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为现代军事后勤以脆弱、高度数字化的骨干为支撑，在未来冲突中极易受到干扰。文中分析潜在崩溃点，并提出通过冗余、去中心化等方式提升韧性的思路。

items.title_en: Bonnie Tyler has died
items.title_zh: Bonnie Tyler 去世
items.summary_en: Obituary noting the passing of singer Bonnie Tyler, reflecting on her enduring hits and impact on rock and pop music.
items.summary_zh: 报道歌手 Bonnie Tyler 去世，并回顾她的经典曲目及对摇滚与流行音乐的影响。

items.title_en: Why developers are ditching GitHub for Codeberg and self-hosting alternatives
items.title_zh: 为何开发者弃用 GitHub 转投 Codeberg 与自托管替代方案
items.summary_en: A growing share of developers are moving away from GitHub toward Codeberg and other self-hosted options due to concerns about data sovereignty, privacy, and platform control. These alternatives offer open-source stacks and greater compliance flexibility, but they trade ecosystem scale and tooling maturity.
items.summary_zh: 越来越多的开发者正在离开 GitHub，转向 Codeberg 与自托管的代码托管方案，原因包括数据主权、隐私与对平台控制权的考量。这些替代方案提供开源栈和更灵活的合规性，但在生态规模和工具链的成熟度上需要权衡。

items.title_en: TLS certificates for internal services done right
items.title_zh: 内部服务的 TLS 证书正确配置
items.summary_en: Best practices for issuing and rotating TLS certificates for internal services, emphasizing automation, short-lived certs, and mTLS between services. Proper internal PKI reduces risk and improves security for service-to-service communication.
items.summary_zh: 内部服务 TLS 证书的最佳实践，聚焦自动化、短期证书和服务间 mTLS。健全的内部公钥基础设施能降低横向渗透风险，提升微服务间通信的安全性。

items.title_en: AI 2040: Plan A
items.title_zh: AI 2040：计划 A
items.summary_en: AI 2040 presents Plan A—a long-range vision for AI governance, safety, and societal impact through 2040, contrasting optimistic and cautionary scenarios.
items.summary_zh: AI 2040 的 Plan A 提出面向2040年的长期愿景，涵盖治理、安全和社会影响等方面，展现乐观与审慎情景的对比。

items.title_en: Opinionated and Easy Pi.dev Configuration
items.title_zh: 对 Pi.dev 配置的主张式与易用性
items.summary_en: The post argues for an opinionated, easy-to-use configuration style for Pi.dev, emphasizing sensible defaults and developer ergonomics. The goal is to reduce cognitive load while keeping builds predictable.
items.summary_zh: 本文主张为 Pi.dev 提供更为固定化、易用的配置风格，强调合理的默认选项与开发者体验。目标是在降低认知负担的同时保持构建的可预测性。

items.title_en: OpenAI faked inability to search training data, hid billions of logs, NYT says
items.title_zh: OpenAI 被指伪称无法搜索训练数据，隐瞒数十亿日志
items.summary_en: The NYT reports claims that OpenAI misrepresented its search capability over training data and hid billions of logs, fueling debate over transparency and accountability in AI vendors. The incident adds pressure on policy and auditing in AI.
items.summary_zh: 纽约时报报道指控 OpenAI 夸大无法搜索训练数据的能力并隐瞒数十亿日志，引发对 AI 供应商透明度的讨论。这件事可能推动对 AI 的政策与审计要求。

items.title_en: The government wants to scare Americans out of sharing the news
items.title_zh: 政府想让美国人不再分享新闻
items.summary_en: A discussion of government attempts to curb sharing of news and information, highlighting implications for press freedom, tech platforms, and user control. It raises concerns about surveillance and information asymmetry.
items.summary_zh: 讨论政府试图限制新闻分享的举措，强调对新闻自由、平台治理与用户自治的影响，关注监控与信息不对称带来的风险。

items.title_en: Decoding the obfuscated bash script on a Uniqlo t-shirt
items.title_zh: 解码优衣库 T 恤上的混淆 Bash 脚本
items.summary_en: Researchers embedded an obfuscated, self-evaluating Bash script on a Uniqlo T-shirt delivered through a CDN. The stunt demonstrates how software-like code can slip into consumer channels via retail distribution, highlighting trust and supply-chain risks. It argues for stronger code provenance checks and verification in modern supply networks.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员在优衣库 T 恤上嵌入一个混淆、可自我评估的 Bash 脚本，并通过 CDN 交付给消费者。这一举动揭示了软件代码通过零售渠道渗透到消费端的风险与供应链信任问题，并呼吁在现代供应链中加强代码来源核验。

items.title_en: Chatto is now open source
items.title_zh: Chatto 现已开源
items.summary_en: Chatto has been released as open source, inviting developers to inspect, contribute, and deploy its chat tooling. The move could spur community-driven improvements, faster adoption, and broader experimentation with chat-powered interfaces.
items.summary_zh: Chatto 已开源，开发者可以审阅、贡献并部署其聊天工具。这一举措有望推动社区协作、加速落地应用并促成更多基于聊天界面的创新。

items.title_en: How to Start a Ruby Meetup
items.title_zh: 如何发起 Ruby Meetup
items.summary_en: A practical guide to launching a Ruby meetup, covering how to find a venue, structure talks, and keep volunteers engaged. It's a useful blueprint for regional developers looking to foster local communities.
items.summary_zh: 该文提供发起 Ruby Meetup 的实用指南，涵盖选取场地、安排演讲结构以及保持志愿者参与度等要点。为希望在本地组建开发者社区的读者提供了可执行的蓝图。

items.title_en: Show HN: Analog Watch
items.title_zh: Show HN：模拟手表
items.summary_en: Show HN introduces Analog Watch, a hardware project showcasing a traditional-timepiece approach with modern hardware or features.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示了模拟手表，这是一个硬件项目，强调传统模拟表的工艺美感，并结合现代硬件特性。

items.title_en: Rewriting Bun in Rust
items.title_zh: 用 Rust 重写 Bun
items.summary_en: Bun, the fast JavaScript runtime, is being rewritten in Rust, a move aimed at boosting performance and ecosystem stability, but it also raises questions about compatibility.
items.summary_zh: Bun 的核心将用 Rust 重写，旨在提升性能与生态稳定性，但也带来兼容性与迁移方面的挑战。

items.title_en: PostHog Open Sourced
items.title_zh: PostHog 开源发布
items.summary_en: PostHog has open-sourced its analytics platform, enabling on-prem deployment and community contributions. This move boosts transparency, data-control, and customization potential for privacy-conscious teams.
items.summary_zh: PostHog 已将其分析平台开源，支持本地部署并接纳社区贡献。这一举措提升了透明度、数据控制以及对隐私敏感团队的定制能力。

items.title_en: How should group chats work in decentralized systems?
items.title_zh: 去中心化系统中的群聊应该如何运作？
items.summary_en: Explores design choices for group chats in decentralized networks, including identity, moderation, and metadata privacy. The piece argues that architecture decisions will shape user experience and resilience in distributed social apps.
items.summary_zh: 探讨去中心化网络中群聊的设计取舍，包括身份、内容审核与元数据隐私等方面。文章指出架构选择将决定分布式社交应用的用户体验与韧性。

items.title_en: Show HN: FableCut – A browser video editor AI agents can drive (zero deps)
items.title_zh: FableCut：浏览器端视频编辑器，AI 代理驱动（零依赖）
items.summary_en: FableCut is a browser-based video editor controlled by AI agents with zero dependencies, illustrating client-side AI tooling and experimentation.
items.summary_zh: FableCut 是一款在浏览器中运行的视频编辑器，由 AI 代理驱动且无需任何依赖，展示了前端 AI 工具化的潜力。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Context.dev (YC S26) – API to get structured data from any website
items.title_zh: Context.dev（YC S26）——从任意网站获取结构化数据的 API
items.summary_en: Context.dev provides an API to extract structured data from any website, enabling agents and tools to reason over web content without bespoke scrapers. It promises easier data extraction but raises questions about data licensing and reliability.
items.summary_zh: Context.dev 提供一个从任意网站提取结构化数据的 API，使代理和工具能够基于网页内容进行推理，而无需定制爬虫。它让数据提取更便捷，但也对数据许可与可靠性提出了相关疑问。

items.title_en: Spider venom kills varroa mites without harming honeybees
items.title_zh: 蜘蛛毒素能杀死瓦螨而不伤蜜蜂
items.summary_en: Spider venom has been shown to kill Varroa destructor mites without harming honeybees, offering a potential breakthrough for beekeeping. If scalable, it could reduce colony losses and chemical miticide use, though delivery methods and safety will matter for adoption.
items.summary_zh: 某种蜘蛛毒素可杀死瓦螨而不伤蜜蜂，为养蜂业带来或许的突破。若能规模化，可能降低蜂群损失与化学杀螨剂的使用，但投放方式、特异性与安全性将决定其推广程度。

items.title_en: GPT‑Live
items.title_zh: GPT-Live
items.summary_en: GPT-Live introduces live, real-time interactions with updated data and external tools, enabling more dynamic conversations. It signals a shift toward apps that continuously consume streams of information rather than static prompts.
items.summary_zh: GPT-Live 引入实时、动态的数据和外部工具交互，使对话具有更即时的更新能力。此举推动应用从静态提示向持续获取信息的对话体验转变。

items.title_en: Grok 4.5
items.title_zh: Grok 4.5
items.summary_en: Grok 4.5 extends the AI assistant's capabilities with better memory, smarter task planning, and improved tool integration. The release emphasizes more reliable automation and streamlined workflows for building AI-powered assistants.
items.summary_zh: Grok 4.5 在记忆、任务规划及对外部工具接入方面有显著提升，提升了自动化的可靠性。此次更新聚焦为构建 AI 助手提供更顺畅的工作流和更高的可用性。

items.title_en: I think I have LLM burnout
items.title_zh: 我可能得了 LLM 倦怠
items.summary_en: The author writes about burnout from relentless AI chatter and feature pressure, urging more sustainable AI workflows and attention to mental health in AI teams.
items.summary_zh: 作者谈及对持续的AI热潮和功能压力带来的倦怠，倡导建立更可持续的AI工作流并关注团队的心理健康。

items.title_en: Why we're moving off Cloudflare Durable Objects
items.title_zh: 为何我们要放弃 Cloudflare Durable Objects
items.summary_en: The team explains why they moved away from Cloudflare Durable Objects, citing latency, consistency, cost, and architectural complexity; discusses alternatives.
items.summary_zh: 团队解释了放弃 Cloudflare Durable Objects 的原因，涉及延迟、数据一致性、成本与架构复杂性，并讨论了替代方案。

items.title_en: TypeScript 7
items.title_zh: TypeScript 7
items.summary_en: TypeScript 7 brings major improvements to the type system, smarter inference, and faster builds, plus new compiler features that reduce runtime errors. It also updates project configuration and editor tooling.
items.summary_zh: TypeScript 7 对类型系统、推断能力和构建速度带来重大改进，并引入新的编译器特性以降低运行时错误。此次发布还对项目配置和编辑器工具链进行了更新。

items.title_en: Syria's solar boom is redefining Middle East's energy model
items.title_zh: 叙利亚的光伏热潮正在重新定义中东的能源模式
items.summary_en: Syria's solar boom is reshaping regional energy dynamics, highlighting decentralization of energy, grid resilience, and geopolitical implications.
items.summary_zh: 叙利亚的光伏热潮正在重塑中东能源格局，凸显能源去中心化、电网韧性及地缘政治影响。

items.title_en: Show HN: Devthropology – Better Insights for GitHub Repos
items.title_zh: Show HN：Devthropology——为 GitHub 仓库提供更好洞察
items.summary_en: Devthropology offers analytics for GitHub repos, surfacing insights like dependencies, health metrics, and contributor trends. It helps maintainers prioritize tech debt and plan community engagement.
items.summary_zh: Devthropology 提供 GitHub 仓库分析，揭示依赖关系、健康指标与贡献者趋势等洞察，帮助维护者优先处理技术债务并规划社区参与。

items.title_en: FAANG Simulator
items.title_zh: FAANG 模拟器
items.summary_en: A practical practice tool designed to simulate FAANG-style interviews, offering prompts, scoring, and feedback to help candidates prepare for big-tech interviews. By exposing candidates to typical formats and questions, it shortens the learning curve and boosts confidence.
items.summary_zh: 这款工具旨在模拟 FAANG 风格的面试，提供题目、打分与反馈，帮助候选人系统备考。通过重复练习常见题型，降低上岸门槛，提升自信与表现。

items.title_en: New open access book on history of computers and politics
items.title_zh: 关于计算机史与政治的新开放获取书籍
items.summary_en: Announces a new open-access book tracing the intertwined histories of computing and politics, touching on tech policy, governance, surveillance, and digital democracy.
items.summary_zh: 宣布出版一本新开放获取书籍，追溯计算机史与政治的交织，覆盖技术治理、监控与数字民主等主题。

items.title_en: Cloudflare Drop
items.title_zh: Cloudflare Drop
items.summary_en: A new Cloudflare project named Drop signals a new product direction from the company.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 推出名为 Drop 的新项目，暗示公司将进入一个新的产品方向。

items.title_en: Show HN: LastShelf – an emergency map of your family's documents bills& contacts
items.title_zh: LastShelf：家庭紧急档案地图
items.summary_en: LastShelf offers an emergency map of essential family documents, bills, and contacts for quick access during crises. It emphasizes offline readiness and controlled sharing, but sensitive data requires careful permissions.
items.summary_zh: LastShelf 提供一个应急用的家庭重要文件、账单与联系人信息地图，便于在危机时快速获取。强调离线可用性和共享控制，但敏感信息需要谨慎授权。

items.title_en: Maxwell's Equations Were Discovered [video]
items.title_zh: 麦克斯韦方程被发现的视频
items.summary_en: A video recounts the historical path to Maxwell's equations, highlighting moments of insight and the unification of electricity, magnetism, and light.
items.summary_zh: 视频回顾麦克斯韦方程组的发现历程，聚焦关键洞见与电磁现象的统一，以及光的本质。

items.title_en: EU now one step away from reviving private message scanning rules
items.title_zh: 欧盟只差一步就能重新启用私信扫描规则
items.summary_en: The EU is nearing revival of private-message scanning rules, aiming to mandate messaging platforms to scan private content for illegal activity. The move would reshape safety vs. privacy dynamics, pressuring platforms to deploy more aggressive monitoring and data processing.
items.summary_zh: 欧盟正在推动重新启用对私信的内容扫描规则，拟要求通讯平台对私人内容进行非法活动的检测。此举将重新定义安全与隐私的平衡，推动更大规模的监控与数据处理，并引发隐私担忧。

items.title_en: Postgres rewritten in Rust, now passing 100% of the Postgres regression tests
items.title_zh: 用 Rust 重写 PostgreSQL，现已通过 100% 回归测试
items.summary_en: A project to rewrite PostgreSQL components in Rust reports passing all regression tests, signaling Rust's viability for safety-critical system software. While not a drop-in replacement, the effort demonstrates how safer memory management and modern tooling could influence database internals.
items.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写 PostgreSQL 组件的尝试声称已通过全部回归测试，显示 Rust 在安全性关键系统中的潜力。虽然不是直接的替代，但这项工作展示了更安全的内存管理与现代工具链对数据库内部实现的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Ways to think about token pricing
items.title_zh: 关于代币定价的思考方式
items.summary_en: Ben Evans outlines frameworks for token pricing, covering utility, network effects, scarcity, and regulatory considerations.
items.summary_zh: Ben Evans 概述了代币定价的框架，涵盖效用、网络效应、稀缺性及监管因素等。

items.title_en: Mistral's Robostral Navigate: a state of the art robotics navigation model
items.title_zh: Mistral 的 Robostral Navigate：前沿机器人导航模型
items.summary_en: Mistral unveils Robostral Navigate, a state-of-the-art robotics navigation model designed to improve real-time planning, obstacle avoidance, and multi-sensor fusion. Early demonstrations suggest stronger robustness and efficiency in dynamic environments, with broad potential for logistics and service robotics.
items.summary_zh: Mistral 发布 Robostral Navigate，这是一款前沿的机器人导航模型，聚焦实时规划、避障和多传感器融合。早期演示显示在动态环境中具备更强鲁棒性与效率，未来可能推动物流、服务机器人等领域。

items.title_en: Show HN: Reverse-engineering web apps into agent tools
items.title_zh: Show HN: 将网页应用反向工程为代理工具
items.summary_en: Show HN describes turning existing web apps into agent tools, enabling automation and composition, while weighing security and reliability implications.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示了将现有网页应用转化为代理工具的思路，便于自动化与组合使用，但也需权衡安全性与可靠性问题。

items.title_en: Auditory and spontaneous movement responses to music over first postnatal year
items.title_zh: 婴儿出生后一年对音乐的听觉与自发运动反应
items.summary_en: A study tracks infants’ auditory perception and spontaneous movement in response to music during the first postnatal year, shedding light on early developmental stages.
items.summary_zh: 研究跟踪婴儿在出生后头一年对音乐的听觉感知与自发运动反应，揭示早期神经与感知发展的关键阶段。

items.title_en: Show HN: Microsoft releases Flint, a visualization language for AI agents
items.title_zh: Show HN：微软发布 Flint——用于 AI 代理的可视化语言
items.summary_en: Flint provides a visual language to model data flows, decisions, and actions for AI agents, enabling rapid prototyping without heavy coding. By graphically mapping agent behavior, teams can design, test, and debug multi-step workflows more efficiently.
items.summary_zh: Flint 提供一种用于 AI 代理的数据流、决策点和执行动作的可视化语言，使团队可以在不写大量代码的情况下快速原型。通过图形化表示代理行为，设计、测试和调试多步骤工作流的效率将显著提升。

items.title_en: How version control will evolve for the agent boom
items.title_zh: 代理热潮下版本控制将如何演进
items.summary_en: Predicts how version control systems will evolve to support AI agents, focusing on provenance, reproducibility, and tooling integration.
items.summary_zh: 预测在 AI 代理热潮中，版本控制系统将如何演化，重点关注溯源性、可重复性与工具链集成。

items.title_en: Separating signal from noise in coding evaluations
items.title_zh: 在编码评估中分辨信号与噪声
items.summary_en: With coding evaluations proliferating in tech hiring, signal can get buried under noise. This piece advocates rigorous evaluation practices—multimetric scoring, blind reviews, and reproducible benchmarks—to measure real coding ability rather than test-taking tricks.
items.summary_zh: 在技术招聘中，编码评估常被大量测试淹没信号。文章主张通过多元指标、盲评和可复现的基准来提炼有用信息，聚焦真实的编程能力，而非考试技巧。

items.title_en: SWE-1.7 Reach Near GPT 5.5 and Opus Intelligence
items.title_zh: SWE-1.7 接近 GPT‑5.5 与 Opus Intelligence
items.summary_en: SWE-1.7 pushes software-engineering AI features toward parity with GPT-5.5 and the Opus Intelligence framework, signaling how AI copilots may soon assist developers more deeply. The discussion covers implications for coding workflows, tool integration, and how teams should architect AI-powered systems. Expect faster prototyping and smarter automation as these capabilities mature.
items.summary_zh: SWE-1.7 的进展让软件工程领域的 AI 辅助能力接近 GPT-5.5 水平与 Opus Intelligence 框架的表现，意味着 AI 助手在编码工作流中的作用将更深。文章探讨了对代码工作流、工具整合以及构建 AI 驱动系统的影响。随着能力成熟，原型设计和自动化水平将显著提升。

items.title_en: We made Grok 4.5, GPT-5.5, and Claude build the same apps
items.title_zh: Grok 4.5、GPT-5.5 与 Claude 一起构建同一应用
items.summary_en: A live-build comparison shows Grok 4.5, GPT-5.5, and Claude building identical apps, highlighting differences in tooling, latency, and integration. The takeaway is that model choice still materially affects product development speed and outcome.
items.summary_zh: 一次实测对比显示 Grok 4.5、GPT-5.5 与 Claude 构建同一应用，揭示了在工具链、延迟和集成方面的差异。结论是模型选择仍会显著影响产品开发速度与结果。

items.title_en: Coordination Without Consolidation: On Systems of States [pdf]
items.title_zh: 无整合的协调：关于国家体系的论述 [PDF]
items.summary_en: A PDF exploring coordination across systems of states without centralized consolidation, offering models for federated governance and interoperability.
items.summary_zh: 一份 PDF 探讨在没有集中整合的情况下，各国家体系如何实现协调，提供联邦治理与互操作性的模型。

items.title_en: AI changes the economics of software rewrites
items.title_zh: AI 改变软件重写的经济学
items.summary_en: AI lowers the cost of rewriting software, accelerating migrations and refactors, and shifting how teams plan tech debt work. The article argues the 'slop' in codebase begins with the base code, suggesting organizations should rethink architecture and test strategies.
items.summary_zh: AI 减少软件重写成本，可能加速迁移与重构，并改变团队处理技术债务的方式。文中指出代码基线质量是关键，建议重新审视架构与测试策略。

items.title_en: A Road to Lisp: Why Lisp
items.title_zh: 走向 Lisp 的路：为何学习 Lisp
items.summary_en: Explores why Lisp remains relevant: powerful macros, homoiconicity, and influence on modern language design and tooling.
items.summary_zh: 探讨 Lisp 仍具相关性的原因：强大的宏、同构性以及对现代语言设计和工具链的影响。

items.title_en: OpenBSD has a use-after-free allowing local privilege escalation to root
items.title_zh: OpenBSD 存在使用后释放漏洞，可能本地提权至 root
items.summary_en: OpenBSD fixes a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow a local user to escalate privileges to root. The flaw highlights the importance of memory-safety in OS kernels and will drive users to apply patches promptly.
items.summary_zh: OpenBSD 发现一个使用后释放漏洞，可能使本地用户提权至 root。相关补丁即将发布，这再次凸显内存安全在内核中的重要性，促使运行中的系统尽快更新。

items.title_en: Transparency efforts behind the Helium Browser
items.title_zh: 背后公开性：Helium 浏览器的透明化努力
items.summary_en: Discusses transparency efforts around Helium Browser, including governance, data handling, and openness in development.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Helium 浏览器在治理、数据处理与开发公开性方面的透明化努力。

items.title_en: Files over tools: how we built our agent with a virtual filesystem and bash
items.title_zh: 文件优先于工具：我们如何用虚拟文件系统和 bash 构建我们的代理
items.summary_en: Describes building an agent around a virtual filesystem and bash, enabling file-based tool discovery and command execution with a lightweight stack.
items.summary_zh: 讲述如何以虚拟文件系统和 bash 为核心构建代理，实现基于文件的工具发现与命令执行，采用轻量化架构。

items.title_en: DeepSeek aims to make its own AI chip
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 打算自研 AI 芯片
items.summary_en: DeepSeek pivots to developing its own AI silicon, signaling a bold hardware strategy in a competitive AI chip landscape.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 转向自研 AI 芯片，代表在竞争激烈的AI芯片领域采取的大胆硬件策略。

items.title_en: How to Write an Email
items.title_zh: 如何写邮件
items.summary_en: A concise guide for writing effective emails, with templates for different intents; focuses on subject lines, concise bodies, and a clear ask.
items.summary_zh: 简明的邮件写作指南，提供针对不同场景的模板，强调标题、简明正文与清晰的请求。

items.title_en: Turning a pile of documents into a searchable useable knowledge base
items.title_zh: 把一堆文档转变为可搜索的知识库
items.summary_en: Turning a pile of documents into a searchable knowledge base is a practical challenge many teams face. The project demonstrates an approach using indexing and semantic search to centralize information and speed up discovery.
items.summary_zh: 一个将零散文档整理为可搜索、可用知识库的示例，借助 DocuBrowser 实现。通过索引、语义搜索和标注等手段，提升信息发现的效率。

items.title_en: How Donkey Kong Toppled Atari
items.title_zh: 《Donkey Kong》如何让 Atari 崩盘
items.summary_en: Donkey Kong's arcade success helped topple Atari by exposing its hardware-focused limits and strategy missteps in the early 1980s. The piece traces licensing dynamics, design choices, and market shifts that reshaped the home gaming landscape.
items.summary_zh: 《Donkey Kong》在街机市场的成功暴露了雅达利以硬件为核心的商业模式的脆弱性，促成了80年代的行业动荡。文章回顾授权、设计选择与市场演变，解释一款游戏如何改变了整个游戏产业的格局。

items.title_en: Remote Attestation
items.title_zh: 远程证明
items.summary_en: Remote attestation cryptographically proves a system’s software and hardware state to a remote party, a cornerstone of trusted computing and supply-chain security. It also introduces privacy and scalability considerations in large distributed setups.
items.summary_zh: 远程证明让设备能向远端对等方以密码学方式证明自身的软件与硬件状态，是可信计算与供应链安全的核心。但在大规模分布式系统中也带来隐私与扩展性的挑战。

items.title_en: New Sweden: the US's long-lost 'secret' colony
items.title_zh: 新斯德兰：美国久失的“秘密”殖民地
items.summary_en: BBC Travel recounts New Sweden, a 17th-century Swedish colony along the Delaware, and how its legacy persists in place names and culture today.
items.summary_zh: 文章回顾新斯德兰在特拉华河地区的17世纪殖民史，以及其在地名与文化中的遗留影响。

items.title_en: MIRA: Multiplayer Interactive World Models Trained on Rocket League
items.title_zh: MIRA：在火箭联盟上训练的多人互动世界模型
items.summary_en: MIRA trains large-scale world models on Rocket League gameplay to enable multiplayer agents that understand and interact in dynamic environments. It demonstrates how game-based data can generalize AI for interactive tasks.
items.summary_zh: MIRA 在 Rocket League 的游戏数据上训练大型世界模型，使多玩家智能体能够在动态环境中理解与互动，展示了以游戏数据为基础推动互动AI泛化的潜力。

items.title_en: OpenMandriva: Statement regarding attempted distribution sabotage
items.title_zh: OpenMandriva：关于尝试分发破坏的声明
items.summary_en: OpenMandriva issued a statement about an attempted sabotage targeting its distribution, outlining affected packages and the security measures taken. The post emphasizes vigilance across mirrors and builds, and invites users to verify integrity.
items.summary_zh: OpenMandriva 就对其发行版的破坏企图公开说明，概述发生了什么以及已采取的安全措施。声明强调对镜像和构建过程的警惕，并敦促用户核对完整性。

items.title_en: Benchmarking coding agents on Databricks' multi-million line codebase
items.title_zh: 在 Databricks 的多百万行代码库上对编码代理进行基准测试
items.summary_en: Databricks benchmarked coding agents against a multi-million-line codebase to gauge their ability to understand and edit real-world enterprise code. The results inform how enterprises should deploy AI copilots and where data quality or context windows bottleneck performance.
items.summary_zh: Databricks 在拥有数百万行代码的代码库上对编码代理进行基准测试，以评估其理解与修改真实企业代码的能力。结果为企业在部署AI编码助手时提供参考，并揭示数据质量与上下文窗口对性能的限制。

items.title_en: A software engineering interview question I like: computing the median
items.title_zh: 一个我喜欢的软件工程面试题：计算中位数
items.summary_en: Using computing the median as a favorite interview prompt, the post illustrates problem-solving, edge cases, and efficiency considerations in real-world coding questions.
items.summary_zh: 以计算中位数为喜爱面试题的例子，展示了在实际编码题中如何进行问题求解、处理边界情况与权衡效率。

items.title_en: What's slowing down the AI buildout
items.title_zh: AI 推进为何受阻？
items.summary_en: The AI buildout is slowed by grid and energy constraints, requiring improvements in hardware efficiency and data-center infrastructure. The article argues that power and cooling, not just compute, bottleneck AI deployment.
items.summary_zh: AI 推进受限于电网和能源约束，需要提升硬件效率与数据中心基础设施。文章强调功率与冷却等因素，而非仅仅是计算能力，是 AI 部署的瓶颈。

items.title_en: Reverse-engineering Nvidia's CUDA-checkpoint for faster cold starts
items.title_zh: 逆向工程英伟达 CUDA 检查点以加速冷启动
items.summary_en: Describes techniques to checkpoint CUDA processes so GPUs can cold-start faster, reducing startup latency for ML workloads.
items.summary_zh: 介绍通过对 CUDA 进程进行检查点化来加速冷启动的方法，降低 ML 工作负载的启动时延。

items.title_en: The internet does not want readers. It wants livestock
items.title_zh: 互联网不想要读者，它要的是牲畜
items.summary_en: Argues that the internet's incentives reward engagement and data extraction over thoughtful readership, critiquing the economics of attention.
items.summary_zh: 指出互联网的激励机制更偏向于争取注意力和数据收集，而非真正的读者体验，批评当下的注意力经济。

items.title_en: A bug which affected only left handed users
items.title_zh: 仅影响左撇子用户的漏洞
items.summary_en: A quirky bug affected only left-handed users, revealing design gaps where user handedness wasn't considered. The incident underscores the importance of inclusive testing and considering diverse interaction patterns.
items.summary_zh: 一个仅影响左撇子用户的有趣漏洞暴露了设计阶段对使用习惯考虑不足。此事凸显了进行包容性测试和覆盖边缘用法的重要性，也提醒开发者在界面布局和交互设计时考虑不同用户群体。

items.title_en: Unicode's transliteration rules are Turing-complete
items.title_zh: Unicode 的转写规则具备图灵完备性
items.summary_en: UTS 35 transliteration rules can simulate a Turing machine, implying that text transformations under Unicode can express arbitrary computation. This raises questions about the limits of decidability and security in text-processing pipelines.
items.summary_zh: UTS 35 的转写规则具备图灵完备性，理论上能把文本转换做成任意计算。这对文本处理管线的可判定性与安全性提出了新挑战。

items.title_en: Show HN: I mapped 8.5M research papers into an interactive atlas
items.title_zh: Show HN：将 850 万篇研究论文映射成一个交互式图谱
items.summary_en: A Show HN project maps 8.5 million research papers into an interactive atlas, enabling new ways to explore scholarly literature and discover connections across fields. It serves as a powerful dataset explorer for researchers and educators.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 项目将 850 万篇研究论文映射到一个交互式图谱，帮助用户以全新方式探索学术文献并发现跨学科关联。对研究人员和教育工作者来说，这是一个强大的数据集探索工具。

items.title_en: Moving to FreeBSD from Linux
items.title_zh: 从 Linux 迁移到 FreeBSD
items.summary_en: A first-hand account of moving from Linux to FreeBSD, detailing benefits like stability and licensing, along with trade-offs in hardware support and ecosystem maturity. It offers practical tips for a smoother transition.
items.summary_zh: 从 Linux 迁移到 FreeBSD 的亲身经历，强调稳定性与许可证等优点，同时也讨论硬件支持与生态成熟度的取舍，给出实用的迁移要点。

items.title_en: Show HN: Yamanote.fun – A complete soundscape for Tokyo's Yamanote line
items.title_zh: Show HN: Yamanote.fun – 东京山手线的完整声音景观
items.summary_en: A playful project that compiles the full soundscape of Tokyo's Yamanote Line, including station announcements, train ambience, and platform sounds. It offers a sonic snapshot of daily urban life and could serve as a creative dataset for audio tooling or AR experiences.
items.summary_zh: Yamanote.fun 汇聚了东京山手线的完整声音景观，包括站内广播、列车声和环境声，呈现日常城市生活的声音快照。该项目也可能成为音频工具或 AR 创作的有趣数据集。

items.title_en: I Built the Only 2026 WWII Jeep
items.title_zh: 我打造了唯一的2026年款二战吉普
items.summary_en: A single-minded build documents a audacious project: a 2026-era WWII Jeep constructed against steep odds, including supply-chain and safety challenges. The effort shows how modern fabrication methods and entrepreneurial risk intersect in ambitious hardware projects.
items.summary_zh: 一位热衷构建者记录了一项极具野心的尝试：打造一辆2026年款的二战吉普，面对供应链、安全性和历史还原等重重挑战。此举展示了现代制造工艺、原型开发与企业级硬件项目风险如何交织。

items.title_en: Ergo: Long Form Philosophy Lectures
items.title_zh: Ergo：长篇哲学讲座
items.summary_en: Ergo offers long-form philosophy lectures, delivering in-depth explorations beyond brief summaries. The platform appeals to people seeking rigorous discourse and a structured pathway through philosophical ideas.
items.summary_zh: Ergo 提供长篇哲学讲座的整理与呈现，带来超越简短摘要的深入探讨。该平台为希望进行系统、严谨论述并深入理解哲学的人提供新的学习路径。

items.title_en: Cargo-nextest: 3x faster than cargo test, per-test isolation, first-class CI
items.title_zh: Cargo-nextest：比 cargo test 快3倍、逐测隔离、CI 更好
items.summary_en: Cargo-nextest promises roughly a 3x speedup over cargo test by isolating tests at the per-test level. It preserves Rust compatibility while delivering faster CI feedback, benefiting large codebases and teams practicing test-driven workflows.
items.summary_zh: Cargo-nextest 通过逐测隔离实现对 cargo test 的约3x加速，提升大型代码库的CI反馈速度，同时保持与 Rust 工具链的兼容性。对推行测试驱动开发的团队尤其有利。

items.title_en: Japan's Hayabusa2 probe to conduct flyby of Torifune asteroid
items.title_zh: 日本的 Hayabusa2 探测器将对 Torifune 小行星进行掠过
items.summary_en: Japan's Hayabusa2 probe will perform a flyby of the Torifune asteroid, expanding its reconnaissance of near-Earth objects. The mission builds on Hayabusa2's heritage of sample collection, contributing data about asteroid composition and evolution.
items.summary_zh: 日本的隼鸟2号探测器将对 Torifune 小行星进行掠过，继续对近地小行星进行探测。该任务延续了 Hayabusa2 的样本返回传统，为了解小行星组成和演化提供新数据。

items.title_en: Meta reuses old RAM in new servers with custom bridge chip
items.title_zh: Meta 在新服务器中重复利用旧 RAM，配合定制桥芯片
items.summary_en: Meta is reusing older RAM in new servers by pairing it with a custom bridge chip to cut costs and improve sustainability. The approach raises questions about reliability, performance consistency, and upgrade paths in hyperscale deployments.
items.summary_zh: Meta 在新服务器中以定制桥芯片搭配，重复利用旧RAM，降低成本并提升数据中心的可持续性。此举也引发关于可靠性、性能一致性及未来升级路径的讨论。

items.title_en: Buried Apple Feature Turns an iPhone into the Perfect Kids' Dumb Phone
items.title_zh: 隐藏的苹果功能将 iPhone 变为理想的儿童简易机
items.summary_en: A hidden iOS feature lets parents limit calls, messages, and apps to turn an iPhone into a simple device for kids. The move highlights ongoing consumer control and parental safety tradeoffs as smartphones become everyday tools.
items.summary_zh: 隐藏的 iOS 功能允许家长限制通话、信息和应用，将 iPhone 打造成简单的儿童设备。这一举措凸显了在智能手机日益普及的同时，用户控制与安全的权衡。

items.title_en: Girls Just Wanna Have Fast MPMC Queues with Bounded Waiting
items.title_zh: 带有界等待的高速 MPMC 队列
items.summary_en: Research presents fast MPMC queues with bounded waiting, addressing a key bottleneck in concurrent data structures. The work offers practical approaches to reduce latency in multi-threaded systems, with potential impact on high-performance services.
items.summary_zh: 研究提出带有界等待的高速多生产者多消费者队列，解决并发数据结构的关键瓶颈。此工作提供降低多线程延迟的实际方法，可能影响高性能服务的性能边界。

items.title_en: Electronic Plastic: Museum of '80s and '90s handheld and tabletop games
items.title_zh: Electronic Plastic：80年代与90年代掌上/桌面游戏博物馆
items.summary_en: Electronic Plastic curates a collection of handheld and tabletop games from the 80s and 90s, preserving hardware and design history. The project offers nostalgia plus technical notes for collectors and researchers.
items.summary_zh: Electronic Plastic 收集并展示80年代与90年代的掌上与桌面游戏，保存硬件与设计史。该项目为收藏者和研究者提供怀旧与技术笔记相结合的资源。

items.title_en: Show HN: Follow London Trains in 3D
items.title_zh: Show HN: 用 3D 跟踪伦敦列车
items.summary_en: Follow London Trains in 3D provides a 3D visualization of London's rail network, offering real-time tracking or replay-style insights. It could be useful for urban planning, transit enthusiasts, or accessibility-focused mapping.
items.summary_zh: Show HN: 用 3D 跟踪伦敦列车提供了伦敦铁路线的三维可视化，可能展示实时轨迹或历史数据。对城市规划、出行爱好者以及无障碍地图等场景都有潜在价值。

items.title_en: TabFont – guitar tabs rendered as you type
items.title_zh: TabFont：打字时实时渲染吉他和弦谱
items.summary_en: TabFont renders guitar tabs in real time as you type, giving musicians an immediate visual preview of fingerings. The project shows how live, domain-specific visualization can improve learning and practice workflows.
items.summary_zh: TabFont 能在你输入时实时渲染吉他和弦谱，立刻给出指法预览。此项目展示了领域专用的实时可视化在学习和练习中的潜力。

items.title_en: Patching MechCommander's "left arm bug" for fun and profit
items.title_zh: 修补 MechCommander 的“左臂漏洞”以求乐趣与利润
items.summary_en: A patch addressing a long-standing left-arm bug in MechCommander has surfaced, illustrating how community-driven fixes can unlock new playstyles or even monetize patches. The tale highlights ongoing maintenance and nostalgia-driven modding in classic games.
items.summary_zh: 针对 MechCommander 长期存在的左臂漏洞的修补补丁浮出水面，展示了社区驱动的修复如何开辟新玩法，甚至带来修补的商业化机会。此事凸显经典游戏的持续维护与怀旧驱动的 Mod 生态。

items.title_en: I Built a Telegram Client for Pi
items.title_zh: 我为树莓派构建了一个 Telegram 客户端
items.summary_en: A Telegram client designed to run on Raspberry Pi demonstrates how to adapt chat apps to low-power devices. It highlights constraints and optimizations for local environments.
items.summary_zh: 作者在树莓派上实现了一个 Telegram 客户端，展示了在资源受限的设备上运行即时通讯应用的可能性与挑战。

items.title_en: Understanding B-Tree Indexes in PostgreSQL: A Comprehensive Guide– Part 1
items.title_zh: PostgreSQL 中的 B-Tree 索引详解（第一部分）
items.summary_en: Part 1 introduces B-tree index theory, structure, and how PostgreSQL uses them to speed lookups. It discusses maintenance costs, vacuum implications, and when to choose B-trees over other index types.
items.summary_zh: 第一部分介绍 B-tree 索引的理论基础、结构以及 PostgreSQL 如何利用它们来加速查询。还讨论了维护成本、清理对性能的影响，以及在 PostgreSQL 中何时选择 B-tree 而非其他索引。

items.title_en: Apache Shiro security framework releases 3.0.0
items.title_zh: Apache Shiro 安全框架发布 3.0.0
items.summary_en: Shiro 3.0.0 represents a major release with breaking changes and a refreshed security API. Upgrading will require attention to deprecated features and migration steps.
items.summary_zh: Shiro 3.0.0 作为重大版本，带来破坏性变更和更新的安全 API。升级时需要关注弃用特性与迁移步骤。

items.title_en: In-browser programmable robot simulator
items.title_zh: 浏览器内的可编程机器人仿真器
items.summary_en: A browser-based robot simulator lets developers write and test control algorithms without physical hardware, lowering barriers to robotics experimentation. It supports basic kinematics, sensors, and real-time feedback, making education and hobbyist prototyping more accessible.
items.summary_zh: 一个浏览器内的机器人仿真器让开发者在无需实体硬件的情况下编写和测试控制算法，显著降低机器人开发的门槛。它支持基本的运动学、传感器和实时反馈，便于教育和爱好者进行原型开发。

items.title_en: What is Bending Spoons? The little-known AOL and Vimeo owner that's now public
items.title_zh: Bending Spoons：这家鲜为人知的 AOL 与 Vimeo 的控股公司如今公开上市
items.summary_en: The piece explains Bending Spoons, a relatively obscure owner of AOL and Vimeo, and its path to going public. It covers the company's unusual trajectory and what its IPO could mean for the media and ad-tech landscape.
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍相对鲜为人知的 Bending Spoons，以及它如何成为 AOL 与 Vimeo 的控股方并走向上市。文章分析了该公司不寻常的成长轨迹及其首次公开发行对媒体与广告科技格局的潜在影响。

items.title_en: My road trip with the do-gooding cactus smugglers
items.title_zh: 与善意仙人掌走私者同行的公路旅行
items.summary_en: A travelogue following a quirky cactus-smuggling team, exploring the ethics, legality, and local ecosystems involved in rare plant trade and conservation culture.
items.summary_zh: 一篇跟随一支古怪的仙人掌走私团队的公路游记，探讨罕见植物贸易中的伦理、法律和对当地生态系统的影响，以及保护文化。

items.title_en: Show HN: Frugon – Find which LLM calls a cheaper model could handle (local, MIT)
items.title_zh: Show HN：Frugon—找出哪些 LLM 调用可以由更便宜的本地模型处理（MIT 开源）
items.summary_en: Frugon is a local-first tool that analyzes prompts to determine whether a cheaper model could handle the LLM call, helping teams cut inference costs without sacrificing quality. Built with MIT-licensed tooling, it helps teams optimize inference spend in real-world workloads.
items.summary_zh: Frugon 是一款本地优先的工具，能够分析提示并判断是否可由更便宜的模型处理某些 LLM 调用，从而降低推理成本。该工具使用本地托管、MIT 许可的组件，帮助团队在实际工作负载中优化成本。

items.title_en: Vacuum at the Page Level
items.title_zh: 页面级真空：Vacuum at the Page Level
items.summary_en: Explores page-level vacuuming in databases and its performance implications, with guidance on when and how to run these operations.
items.summary_zh: 讲解数据库的页面级清理（Vacuum）及其对性能的影响，并提供何时以及如何执行的指南。

items.title_en: Beyond Git: Real-Time Version Control for Godot – Lilith Duncan – GodotCon 2026 [video]
items.title_zh: 超越 Git：Godot 的实时版本控制
items.summary_en: Lilith Duncan discusses real-time version control tailored for Godot development, focusing on fast iteration, live collaboration, and tooling that fits game-dev workflows.
items.summary_zh: Lilith Duncan 讨论面向 Godot 开发的实时版本控制，着重于快速迭代、实时协作，以及适配游戏开发工作流的工具设计。

items.title_en: Lead Mines of Galena, Kansas
items.title_zh: 加仑纳的铅矿
items.summary_en: A historical piece about lead mining in Galena, Kansas, detailing its discovery, operation, and impact on the town.
items.summary_zh: 聚焦堪萨斯州盖勒纳铅矿的历史，介绍发现、开采过程及对小镇发展的影响。

items.title_en: 3D Airplane tracker on Mercator map
items.title_zh: 在墨卡托地图上的3D飞机跟踪器
items.summary_en: A real-time 3D airplane tracker overlays live flight data on a Mercator map with interactive 3D visuals. The project demonstrates modern web visualization of geospatial data and could inform more immersive flight-tracking dashboards.
items.summary_zh: 一个实时的3D飞机追踪器在墨卡托地图上叠加实时航班数据并以交互式3D呈现，体现了现代网页技术在地理数据可视化中的应用潜力。它为飞行追踪仪表板和数据可视化提供了有力的概念验证。
